datasets.name: rats
datasets.description: Historical control data of tumor incidence in 71 groups of female laboratory rats (Tarone, 1982).

columns.study_id: Identifier for each of the 71 laboratory experiments
columns.y: Number of rats with tumors (successes / cases)
columns.n: Total number of rats in the study group

datasets.pymc_use_case: Hierarchical Beta-Binomial or Logit-Normal model estimating population distribution of tumor risks and individual group shrinkage.

datasets.name: light
datasets.description: Simon Newcomb's 66 measurements of the passage time of light (1882), recorded as deviations from 24,800 nanoseconds.

columns.deviation_ns: Recorded deviation in nanoseconds from 24,800 ns
columns.speed_km_s: Speed of light estimate calculated over 7.442 km path

datasets.pymc_use_case: Comparison of Normal likelihood (sensitive to the two extreme negative outliers -44 and -2) vs. robust Student-t likelihood with degrees of freedom nu.

datasets.name: golf
datasets.description: Professional golf putting success rates by distance from hole (in feet), based on 1988 PGA Tour data.

columns.distance_ft: Distance to the hole in feet (2 to 20 feet)
columns.n_attempts: Total number of putts attempted at this distance
columns.success_rate: Empirical proportion of putts made (y / n)

datasets.pymc_use_case: Physics-based non-linear Bayesian model where probability of holing is 2*Phi(arcsin((R-r)/x) / sigma) - 1, compared to standard logistic regression.

datasets.name: meta
datasets.description: Meta-analysis of 22 clinical trials of beta-blockers for reducing mortality after myocardial infarction (Yusuf et al., 1985).

columns.control_deaths: Number of deaths in the control group
columns.control_total: Total patients in the control group
columns.treated_deaths: Number of deaths in the beta-blocker treated group
columns.treated_total: Total patients in the treated group

datasets.pymc_use_case: Hierarchical meta-analysis model estimating overall treatment efficacy (log odds ratio) and study-to-study heterogeneity tau.

datasets.name: football
datasets.description: NFL football scores and point spreads across 10 seasons (1981, 1983-1986, 1988-1992), 224 games per season.

columns.home_favored: 1 if the favorite played at home, 0 otherwise
columns.favorite_score: Points scored by the favored team
columns.underdog_score: Points scored by the underdog team

datasets.pymc_use_case: Testing the efficient market hypothesis on point spreads and modeling score differential variability (Normal with variance ~ 14^2).

datasets.name: fabric
datasets.description: Faults in 32 rolls of fabric of varying lengths manufactured in a textile plant (Hinde, 1982).

columns.length: Length of fabric roll in meters
columns.faults: Count of faults detected in the roll

datasets.pymc_use_case: Poisson regression with log(length) exposure offset or Negative-Binomial regression to account for overdispersion.

datasets.name: schizophrenia
datasets.book_chapter: Chapter 18 (Models for Missing Data / Finite Mixtures)
datasets.description: Reaction times (in milliseconds) for 11 non-schizophrenic controls and 6 schizophrenic patients (30 trials each, Belin & Rubin 1990).
datasets.pymc_use_case: Hierarchical mixture model with subject-level random effects and an attentional lapse component.

datasets.name: cow
datasets.description: Effect on milk production and health metrics of a dietary additive given to 50 dairy cows.
datasets.pymc_use_case: Linear mixed models / causal inference adjusting for pre-treatment baseline covariates (lactation, initial weight, age).

datasets.name: dilution
datasets.description: Serial dilution laboratory assays for 10 unknown samples and standard titration curves.
datasets.pymc_use_case: Non-linear calibration curve (4-parameter logistic or sigmoidal curve) estimating unknown specimen concentrations.

datasets.name: election_2008
datasets.description: State-level popular and electoral results for the 2008 US Presidential Election (Obama vs. McCain).

columns.vote_obama: Total popular votes cast for Barack Obama
columns.vote_obama_pct: Percentage of popular votes for Obama
columns.vote_mccain: Total popular votes cast for John McCain
columns.vote_mccain_pct: Percentage of popular votes for McCain
columns.electoral_vote_dem: Electoral college votes awarded to Democratic candidate
columns.electoral_vote_rep: Electoral college votes awarded to Republican candidate

datasets.pymc_use_case: Bayesian state-level poll aggregation and predictive forecasting of electoral vote tallies.

datasets.name: newyork
datasets.description: 1960 Census populations of cities and towns in New York State with dual sampling inclusion codes.

columns.code: Sampling inclusion status code (100=neither, 200=both, 300=sample 2 only, 400=sample 1 only)

datasets.pymc_use_case: Survey sampling weights, capture-recapture estimation, and finite population inference.

datasets.name: stratified
datasets.description: Stratified survey of 1,447 US adults across 16 geographical/density strata evaluating voting preferences.

columns.region: US geographic region (Northeast, Midwest, South, West)
columns.density_tier: Population density tier (I, II, III, IV)
columns.bush_pct: Support proportion for George H.W. Bush
columns.stratum_pop_share: Proportion of total US population residing in this stratum

datasets.pymc_use_case: Post-stratification (MRP) and hierarchical multinomial-Dirichlet estimation across strata.

datasets.name: kidney_cancer_1980_1984
datasets.description: US County-level kidney cancer deaths, populations, and age-adjusted rates (1980-1984).
datasets.pymc_use_case: Empirical Bayes and Poisson-Gamma / spatial CAR smoothing to demonstrate why maps of raw rates are misled by small-population sample noise.
